Name: Ellie's Decorative Fences and Gates
Author: EllieBellaLuna
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Ellie's Decorative Fences and Gates[/b][/size]

[size=3]Adds new fences that give your farm more flair. To get the decorative gates for each fence, place a gate on an already placed fence. All fences can be bought from Robin's shop.
[/size]
[/center][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11450/11450-1648357534-541164667.gif[/img]﻿[/center]


[center][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
SMAPI
SpaceCore
Expanded Preconditions Utility
JSON Assets[/center]
